comparison.interpretation: Post-evaluation descriptive comparison; no model fitting, threshold selection or promotion. Execution variants are averaged within each base episode before bootstrapping.

limitations: Post-evaluation descriptive analysis; no model selection or retuning
Binary settled positions only; proportional per-asset cash-flow allocation includes fill fees
Residual shares describe executed legs before settlement, not remaining terminal inventory
Execution variants are correlated within source groups; no independent-sample inference
Attribution is accounting decomposition, not causal identification or an executable recovery policy
Synthetic hypothetical outcomes; no empirical fill calibration or real profitability claim

limitations: Directed family selection uses previously observed failures; results do not represent all synthetic families
Two conditions in each cycle share source groups; cycles use disjoint seeds
Adaptive delay assignment is exploratory; no estimated population break-even frontier
Frozen gate and weights; no selection, retraining or promotion from challenge outcomes
Synthetic hypothetical outcomes; no empirical calibration or real profitability
The cycle-one baseline already has a negative downside score; this does not replicate a positive-to-negative reversal.
Within-cycle comparisons are paired; 200ms versus 400ms belongs to different fresh cohorts.
Cycle-one mean-change interval includes zero; positive point downside score does not prove robustness.
